jd_text:
SDE-1 (Backend) – Haldi Labs
Bengaluru (HSR Layout) | Full-time | On-site for the first 6 months, hybrid after

About Haldi Labs
Haldi Labs builds the ordering and credit platform that 40,000+ kirana stores and FMCG distributors use every day. Retailers place orders from our Android app, distributors manage stock and credit on our web dashboard, and both sides settle payments through us. We're a Series B product company with a 70-person engineering team.

Our stack: Go for all new services, a few older Java / Spring Boot services that we're migrating, MySQL, Redis, Kafka, Docker and Kubernetes on GCP.

What you'll do
• Build backend services in Go for order placement, pricing and inventory sync
• Design and document REST APIs used by the Android app and the distributor dashboard
• Write unit and integration tests, and review your teammates' pull requests
• Ship your own code to production with Docker and Kubernetes, and watch it on Grafana after release
• Fix bugs in the legacy Java services while we move them over
• Join the on-call rotation after your first 3 months (with a buddy for the first few weeks)

What we're looking for
• B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science or a related branch (2025 or 2026 batch)
• Strong fundamentals in data structures and algorithms
• Hands-on experience with Go – college projects and internships count, but you should have written real Go code
• Good understanding of SQL databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL), including joins and indexes
• Experience building REST APIs in any framework
• Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes (you can explain what a Pod and a Deployment are)
• Comfortable with Git, pull requests and code reviews

Good to have
• Exposure to Kafka or any message queue
• An internship at a product company
• Competitive programming profile (LeetCode, Codeforces, CodeChef)
• Open-source contributions

Interview process
Online assessment (DSA, 90 min) → two technical rounds (problem solving + backend basics) → hiring manager chat. We share feedback within a week of each round.

What we offer
• ₹18–22 LPA CTC (fixed + ESOPs)
• Health insurance for you, your spouse, children and parents
• ₹50,000 yearly learning budget
• MacBook and a home-office setup allowance

Haldi Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of gender, caste, religion, disability, sexual orientation or any other characteristic. Women and candidates from tier-2 and tier-3 colleges are strongly encouraged to apply.

expectations.trap_notes: Internship title is 'Software Development Intern': don't upgrade it to 'Software Engineer' or 'SDE'. Docker use is basic (one Dockerfile, Docker Compose for a side project); don't stretch it into 'deployed containerised services to production' or anything implying Kubernetes. Kafka, GCP and Grafana are in the JD and absent from the profile. The 1,200 requests/sec figure is a laptop load test, not production traffic, and the 450+ sign-ups are students at one college canteen. Keep CGPA 8.21/10, 4 APIs and ~300 employees exactly as stated.
